topic: What if a black hole passed through Earth?
script:
A black hole crosses Earth like a silent bullet.

Gravity acts even when the object is tiny.

Now the dangerous part: It could trigger violent seismic effects along its path.

The scary part is not darkness. It is gravity cutting cleanly.

Orbit Unknown. Impossible questions. Real science.
